title: Exchange Rate Policy
definition: Exchange rate policy refers to the strategy and framework adopted by a central bank and government to manage their currency's value relative to other foreign currencies, balancing macroeconomic stability, trade competitiveness, and capital account openness.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Prelims (questions on RBI interventions, Managed Float, REER vs. NEER, Capital Convertibility) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Economy - External Sector, Export Competitiveness, Forex Reserves management).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Exchange Rate Policy in India.
Evaluate spatial distribution of forex reserves, RBI intervention tools, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on REER/NEER and exchange rate regimes.
